title: Band uniforms in New Orleans: Ory's blues, Eagle brown, Imperial
summary: Discussion of band uniforms: Eagle Band brown, Imperial and Ory's blue, caps, and Lil's uniform in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask you, when you mentioned about playing, did they, in the old days in New Orleans, did they have different uniforms? Seems like somebody called them.
Yeah. Yeah, well, that's the way it is. We got military uniforms.
Somebody talked about the boys in blue. Which band was that? Maybe Johnny St. Cyr was telling me. Wasn't it the boys in brown?
Well, I was trying to introduce them. And there's Eagle Band. Eagle Band had brown uniforms. We had a revelation blue uniform.
The Ori Band.
Just like the Imperial Band had.
The Imperial had blues.
They had blues too.
And that's the Ori Band that you had?
We had blue ones with Ori. Ori's Band on it. Ori's Band. Did you have caps?
Yeah. For the dance, not the brass band, but inside too.
That was for the orchestra. We had caps, oris. Just like the brass band. Like a military uniform.
Did they wear those caps inside too? Yeah.
Yeah.
Did they dress up that way?
We got our uniforms, yeah.
Yeah, I forget about those. Nowadays they never have any special.

No, nowadays. Now, lately you wear, we used to wear it. We had different suits. We had gray. And we had some kind of a light brown uniform. We'd buy a suit. It was up to us. Well, it was up to me. I used to be the one in charge of all that. Picking out the suits, you know. We'd have them made, you know. We'd wear clothes, you see.
Yeah, I was wondering about those.

Yeah, we used to wear uniforms. Military uniforms. And we got to Chicago, we had brown there. Lil had her one made. Oh, even places like the Greenland and all that? Yeah, Lil, she had her one made. She wore a uniform, kept and everything just like us.
I never knew that.
I never saw it. Yeah.
